title: Microsoft Purview: Azure PST Import to Exchange Online mailboxes
summary: The briefing matches the Worldwide roadmap item and Microsoft's updated rollout notice. The Azure role-assignment controls, published bulk-PST-import licensing rights and Blob Storage meters are supported; no corrections are required.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to import PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage directly into Exchange Online mailboxes.
claims.quote: Azure PST Import is a migration method that enables PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage to be imported directly into Exchange Online mailboxes.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes a two-step Exchange Migration Service pattern consisting of analysis and migration.
claims.quote: It follows the standard two-step Exchange Migration Service pattern: an initial analysis phase to validate and assess PST data, followed by execution of the actual migration.

claims.quote: The process also involves creating a migration endpoint
